rating_source: IMPORTANT DISCOVERY-VS-LIVE DISCREPANCY, documented in full: the task brief (from an earlier discovery pass) recorded 'rating: 4.9, 15 reviews'. A fresh, direct live fetch of the GreenPal profile page on 2026-08-08 (https://www.yourgreenpal.com/greenleaf-pro-garden, curl + Chrome UA, HTTP 200, full HTML parsed) shows the vendor has grown substantially since discovery: the page's own LocalBusiness JSON-LD now gives aggregateRating {ratingValue: 4.78, reviewCount: 73, ratingCount: 73, bestRating: 5, worstRating: 1}. The page's own visible UI text independently shows a rounded 'Overall rating 4.7/5' and '(75 reviews)' near the review-count link (a UI-rounding discrepancy of the same kind documented for rapalo-landscaping-north-miami, where JSON-LD 4.76 vs UI-rounded 4.7 was resolved in favor of the more precise JSON-LD figure). The business's own page states 'In Business since Mar, 26' (March 2026), consistent with a very young, fast-growing operation gaining reviews quickly since the brief's original discovery snapshot. Per the same precedent, this site uses the live, more precise JSON-LD figures (4.78 rating, 73 reviews) rather than the stale discovery numbers or the UI-rounded display, since they are the freshest verified data directly from the source. NOTE: a web-search-engine AI summary encountered during research also claimed unsourced marketing statistics ('19 property projects in the last 60 days', 'active across East Park and Engelwood Park', 'responds within 1 hour') -- these phrases were checked directly against the raw fetched HTML of both the GreenPal and Nextdoor pages and do NOT appear anywhere in either page's actual source; they were treated as unverified/likely-fabricated search-summary embellishment and were NOT used anywhere on the site.

images.source: GreenPal's own ImageObject JSON-LD gallery for this vendor lists 48 before/after lawn-care photo URLs (greenpal-production.s3.amazonaws.com), geotagged 31x 'Orlando, FL', 16x 'Kissimmee, FL', 1x 'Bvl, FL'. All 48 were downloaded directly with curl + Chrome UA and verified with `file` as real baseline JPEGs, 340x255px (GreenPal's native small resolution, same size class as every other GreenPal-sourced landscaping build in this project). Every photo carried a baked-in 'GREENPAL' logo watermark (top ~42px band) and a caption band (bottom ~34px); all were cropped with Pillow (Python) to remove both bands before curation (340x179px after crop), per DESIGN.md's prohibition on gallery captures with text overlays. The 16 Kissimmee-tagged photos (matching the business's own registered city) were assembled into a contact sheet and visually inspected one by one (Read tool) before final selection; all 16 were clean, well-lit, watermark-free residential lawn photos with no people, no clutter and no text overlays, well above the 5-photo usability minimum. 8 were selected for the site (1 hero, 2 about, 5 gallery, with 1 photo intentionally reused between the About and Gallery sections and 1 between the Hero and Ubicacion/Service-Area sections, matching the limited-photo-reuse pattern already used on valeria-landscape-north-miami and rapalo-landscaping-north-miami). The remaining 8 unused Kissimmee-tagged photos and all 31 Orlando-tagged + 1 Bvl-tagged photos were left unused; none were needed given the strong Kissimmee-tagged set. The vendor's own GreenPal profile photo (a 400x300 headshot at greenpal-production.s3.amazonaws.com/ztp2whyrg2vw4tvqyy5w2b31ikdp) was also downloaded and inspected but is a poor-quality, unflattering low-angle selfie with eyes half-closed; per DESIGN.md's rule against low-quality owner photos, it was NOT used anywhere on the site (not even as a small avatar), and the nav/footer/about-avatar logo slots instead use a plain text monogram ('GP' for the brand, 'ER' for the owner Emmanuel Rodriguez), the same adaptation used by rapalo-landscaping-north-miami for its missing founder photo.

palette.name: greenleaf-olive-lime
palette.note: Derived from templates/dark-v2 (Pure Artistry's gold #d4a84b/#b8934a skeleton) via a systematic HSL hue-rotation (hue -> 88deg, olive-lime green) applied in Python via colorsys to every hex and rgba color literal in the template, preserving each color's original lightness/saturation so every gradient, shadow and glass-border relationship stays intact (same method as rapalo-landscaping-north-miami's jade palette, generalized with colorsys instead of a hand-picked map). Checked against every other landscaping build already in output/ as of 2026-08-08: otechlandscaping's forest #3d6b2f (light, hue~106), papa-green-lawn-care-brandon's turf #2b6a38 (light, hue~132), garden-now-landscaping-orlando's olive #45703a (light, hue~101), pride-landscaping-cape-coral's bright grass #55ca65 (dark, hue~128), bonzailandscapingportstlucie's sky blue #48a7d7 (dark, hue~200), valeria-landscape-north-miami's teal #146b60 (light, hue~172), rapalo-landscaping-north-miami's jade #4bd490 (dark, hue~150). #94d44b (hue~88deg) is a distinct, more yellow-leaning olive-lime green, clearly different from every hex/hue above. imagine-it-gardening-pembroke-pines was checked too but was still on its unmodified template palette (#a04a72, Lash Bloom's original plum-pink) at the time of this build, meaning no palette choice had been committed there yet to conflict with.

build_notes: Derived from templates/dark-v2/index.html (Pure Artistry skeleton) following templates/SKELETONS-V2.md's anchored-replacement method via scripts/build_greenleaf-pro-garden-kissimmee.py: (1) systematic HSL hue-rotation palette swap (hue->88deg olive-lime) computed with Python colorsys over every hex/rgba literal in the template, with the .merktop-badge/.merktop-dot/@keyframes mkPulse block protected via a @@BADGE@@ token during the swap so it stays gold as required; (2) full head block replaced (title/meta/og/icon inline-SVG monogram/JSON-LD, type LandscapingBusiness with real address/phone/rating/areaServed/makesOffer, no fabricated legal entity name since none was found); (3) nav/footer/about-avatar logo image slots replaced with text monograms ('GP' brand, 'ER' owner) since the only available owner photo was an unusable low-angle selfie; (4) every section's copy rewritten in both data-es/data-en per DESIGN.md bilingual rules, grounded in the real GreenPal meta description, FAQ answers, reviews and stats, zero invented services/prices/reviews; (5) VARIANTE ADAPTADA per FORGE-BRIEF 0.b: services grid rebuilt via regex block-replace with 4 real FAQ-grounded service cards and no fixed prices (quote-based 'Get a quote' CTA throughout), Opiniones grid reduced from the skeleton's default 3-card grid to a real 2-card grid (only 2 of the 20 shown GreenPal reviews had genuinely positive body text), and the Ubicacion/map iframe replaced with a real photo since the registered address is not a public storefront (mobile lawn-care crew); (6) every Booksy/Instagram link repointed to the real GreenPal profile as primary CTA with the verified phone (407) 553-1467 as a secondary channel throughout, and the footer 'Follow' column repointed to GreenPal + Nextdoor (no Instagram found), mirroring the rapalo-landscaping-north-miami precedent's directory-fallback pattern.
